summary: The EmailPopupDocument service is designed to manage documents associated with email popups by storing, searching, and deleting entries based on provided data information.
purpose: The purpose of the EmailPopupDocument service is to facilitate the management of email-associated documents, enabling operations such as searching for document entries and deleting them from the file system.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: A unique identifier for the email document entry.

fields.name: FileName
fields.description: The name of the email document.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.description: The file path where the email document is stored.

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: A flag indicating whether the document has been checked.

workflows.name: Search Email Documents
steps: Parse DataInfo into email document details.
For each document, create an EmailPopupDocument entry with ID, FileName, and FilePath.
Return a list of EmailPopupDocument entries.

workflows.name: Delete Email Document
steps: Parse DataInfo to locate the document by ID.
Delete the file at the specified FilePath.
Attempt to delete the folder if empty.

validations: Check if DataInfo is not null or empty before proceeding with operations.
Ensure emailData contains the expected format before accessing elements.
system_behavior: Uses DataInfo to parse and manage email document data.
Implements file operations to delete documents.
